text:
deploybot: Deploy request opened by jamie for inference-api -> redwood/inference:2.3.1-hotfix
jamie: Urgent hotfix. Tokenizer edge-case causing 5xx bursts on longer prompts (see logs). Need a small-window rollout tonight 22:00-02:00. Requesting expedited approvals.
lisa: Can we keep canary <= 10% and monitor error-rate & latency for 5m? I can watch metrics during rollout (oncall).
sanjay: I'll be the pager backup. Need explicit rollback steps and a pinned image if we cut.
jamie: Rollback command: `kubectl set image deployment/inference-api inference-api=redwood/inference:2.3.0 -n prod`
jamie: Short repro logs pasted: ```ERROR 2026-03-21T22:03:12Z tokenizer: index out of range -> 500 internal; stack traces show whitespace token edge-case at decode()```
emily: Product signoff: major customers seeing timeouts. We need this fixed tonight. Approve expedited if SRE OK. :pray:
mike: Quick check from infra: image build passed integration tests, no DB migrations. Approve from infra side. :+1:
security-bot: Automated scan: no new outbound connections, no secret rotations in this image. No security blockers.
olivia: Note: release notes need callout for behavior change in tokenizer fallback; I'll update docs after cutover.
lisa: Approve to proceed with canary at 5% now that we have rollback and scans. Conditions: monitor error_rate < 0.5% and p95 latency within 20% of baseline for 5m.
jamie: Setting canary to 5% and pinning image in rollout policy now. Config snippet: `deploy.rollout: {"strategy": "canary", "steps": [5, 50, 100], "pinned_image": "redwood/inference:2.3.1-hotfix"}`
deploybot: Canary rollout started at 5777554780 — inference-api -> 2.3.1-hotfix (5%)
lisa: Canary metrics 2m in: error_rate spiked to 0.8% then dropped to 0.2%; p95 latency +18% — within thresholds. Continuing to 50%.
sanjay: I'm seeing no new alerts on pager. Proceed to ramp.
mike: 50% ramp started. Watching autoscaler and GPU utilization.
jamie: Pushing release note draft: https://internal.redwood/release-notes/2.3.1-hotfix (short blurb + migration note).
security-bot: Confirmed post-canary quick scan ok.
lisa: 5m post-50% stable, metrics green. Approving final ramp to 100%.
deploybot: Rolling to 100% at 5777555001
jamie: Pinned deployment manifest updated in repo: `infra/manifests/inference-api.yaml@2.3.1-hotfix`
olivia: Updated release notes and customer-facing blurb in docs.
mike: Observability check: traces look nominal, error traces mostly from pre-cutover timeframe.
emily: Thanks everyone — product approves final cut. Prioritizing follow-up email to impacted accounts.
sanjay: Final rollback criteria documented: immediate rollback if 5xx rate >1% sustained for 3m or error spike correlated with CPU/GPU >85% for >2m.
deploybot: Rollout complete at 5777555120 — inference-api is now at redwood/inference:2.3.1-hotfix (100%)
jamie: Closing thread. Will open a brief post-deploy note in #releases tomorrow with timestamps and any follow-ups.
olivia: I'll track doc updates and customer notif. Thanks all for quick approvals. :rocket:
